'''FC Slutsk''', officially '''Football Club Slutsk-2024''' ({{langx|ru|Футбольный клуб «Слуцк-2024»}}) and formerly '''SFC Slutsk''', is a [[Belarus]]ian [[association football]] club based in [[Slutsk]], [[Minsk Oblast]]. Founded in 1998 with the backing of the local sugar refinery, the club spent twelve seasons in the [[Belarusian Premier League]] between 2014 and 2025 and attracted a global online following during the [[COVID-19 pandemic]] in 2020, when the Belarusian league was one of the few in the world still playing. Since early 2025 the club has been run as a state institution of the [[Slutsk District]] Executive Committee. As of the 2026 season, Slutsk play in the [[Belarusian First League]], the second tier of Belarusian football."}}
